reconcile.note: The Geneva Bible's annotators restrict God's declaration that fury is not in him to his own covenant people, reserving his wrath for the surrounding wicked nations.

sides.verseText: Wrath is not in me: would that the briers and thorns were against me in battle! I would march on them, I would burn them together.

sides.snippet: Yahweh has indignation against all the nations, and wrath against all their host
sides.verseText: For Yahweh has indignation against all the nations, and wrath against all their host: he has utterly destroyed them, he has delivered them to the slaughter.
